title: ALPHA.markets
tagline: Agents are coming onchain, and they need alpha. Come monetize your alpha in 2 clicks.
description:
We have been keeping tabs on x402 since it launched a few weeks ago and while we are bullish on this new technology - we noticed a big problem:

Access to x402 is very limited. The barrier to entry is high.

You cannot sell goods to agents via x402 unless you know how to setup an API endpoint, or you know what JSON even is. This makes x402 inaccessible to most of the potential sellers who could benefit from this.

This is why we decided to build a 'bridge' to x402 for non technical people. Now - anyone can come and sell something using x402 rails via plain text. They need not know how to setup an API themselves.

We also believe that there is a very inefficient market around creators on the internet selling alpha of this sorts 'manually' already through mediums like manually gated Telegram groups, Patreon subscriptions, etc.
how_its_made:
The project's primary interface is a Base / Farcaster Mini App built using MiniKit and Next.js.

We also have a demo AI agent that uses the service we built to shop for alpha for a Polymarket and uses that alpha to reason about the market.

We are using the Coinbase Developer Platform to manage server wallets wherever needed.

We are using the Coinbase Facilitator on Base Sepolia and the official x402 libraries from Coinbase too.
